text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Website and Spec

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/spec/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PATH: ${{ env.PATH }}:${{ github.workspace }}/target/release
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install mdbook
        run: cargo install --locked mdbook

      - name: Build mdbook-spec preprocessor
        run: cargo build --release -p mdbook-spec

      - name: Build website
        run: mdbook build website

      - name: Build spec
        run: mdbook build docs/spec --preprocessor mdbook-spec

      - name: Prepare public folder
        run: |
          mkdir -p public/website
          cp -r website/book/* public/website/
          mkdir -p public/spec
          cp -r docs/spec/book/* public/spec/

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          branch: gh-pages
          folder: public
          commit-message: Deploy website and spec
          clean: true
```
